headquarters: London, UK (Global HQ); New York, NY (Americas HQ)
description: AlphaSights is a global expert network that connects decision-makers at leading investment firms, consultancies, and corporations with domain experts for primary research. Founded in London in 2008, the firm has grown rapidly to over 2,000 employees across nine offices worldwide and raised $400 million in September 2024 at a reported $4.2 billion valuation. AlphaSights differentiates through speed of expert delivery, high-touch project management, and increasingly AI-augmented workflows via its AlphaGPT, AlphaGraph, and AlphaNow platforms.

overview: AlphaSights connects decision-makers at investment firms, consultancies, and corporations with professionals who have relevant domain knowledge. The firm's core value proposition is speed and service quality — it often delivers expert matches within hours and assigns dedicated project teams to manage client engagements end-to-end. AlphaSights has expanded beyond basic expert calls into an increasingly AI-augmented platform that includes the AlphaNow content library, AlphaGPT conversational AI, and AlphaGraph ML-powered expert matching. In September 2024, the company raised $400 million in growth funding at a reported $4.2 billion valuation, led by Carlyle and TA Associates.

history.narrative: AlphaSights was founded in 2008 in London by Andrew Sherwood. The company began as a lean expert network focused on speed and service quality for European investment firms. It expanded rapidly, opening offices across key financial centers and growing its team from a small London operation to over 2,000 employees globally. AlphaSights has appeared on several fast-growth lists, including the Financial Times' Europe's Fastest-Growing Companies and the Sunday Times Fast Track 100 for five consecutive years. In 2024, the company raised a landmark $400 million funding round, underscoring its position as one of the most valuable private companies in the expert-network category.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Calls
servicesDetailed.description: AlphaSights' core offering: one-on-one or multi-party calls with domain experts matched to specific client questions. The firm emphasizes turnaround speed, often connecting clients with relevant experts within hours. Dedicated project teams manage sourcing, scheduling, compliance checks, and follow-up.

servicesDetailed.name: Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: Quantitative and qualitative B2B surveys sourced through AlphaSights' expert network and broader respondent panels. Surveys can be paired with follow-up calls for deeper exploration or used standalone for market sizing, sentiment analysis, and competitive benchmarking.

servicesDetailed.name: AlphaNow
servicesDetailed.description: A proprietary content library featuring weekly expert-sourced insights, interview transcripts, and analysis pieces. AlphaNow provides reusable research content that clients can access without scheduling individual calls, complementing the firm's bespoke call-based model.

servicesDetailed.name: AlphaGPT
servicesDetailed.description: A conversational AI tool that helps clients synthesize research, generate project briefs, summarize expert calls, and extract key themes across multiple interactions. AlphaGPT represents AlphaSights' push into AI-augmented research workflows.

servicesDetailed.name: Proprietary Events
servicesDetailed.description: Curated roundtables and discussion events that bring together multiple experts and clients around specific industry themes or market developments. Events complement one-on-one calls by providing broader perspective-gathering opportunities.

servicesDetailed.name: Custom Research Projects
servicesDetailed.description: Multi-method research engagements combining calls, surveys, events, and content into structured project deliverables. Designed for due diligence, market landscape assessments, and complex strategic questions requiring multiple expert perspectives.

aiPlatform.narrative: AlphaSights has invested significantly in technology and AI to augment its human-driven expert matching model. AlphaGraph is the firm's ML-powered matching engine that uses structured data and interaction history to identify the most relevant experts for each project. AlphaGPT, launched more recently, provides conversational AI capabilities for research synthesis, automated call summaries, and brief generation. The firm also offers a centralized dashboard for managing transcripts, recordings, and team collaboration. These tools sit alongside — rather than replace — AlphaSights' high-touch project management model.

complianceExtended.narrative: AlphaSights maintains a dedicated compliance function that manages MNPI screening, expert vetting, conflict-of-interest checks, and interaction monitoring. The firm describes its compliance framework as built into every stage of the expert engagement workflow, with automated checks before and after interactions. AlphaSights enforces cooling-off periods for public-company employees and maintains full audit trails of expert interactions.

complianceExtended.regulatoryContext: No major public regulatory action has been identified against AlphaSights. The firm has operated since 2008 without significant public compliance incidents. As with all expert networks, AlphaSights operates in a regulatory environment shaped by the insider-trading enforcement wave of the early 2010s, and its compliance infrastructure reflects the heightened standards that emerged from that period.

clientFit.narrative: AlphaSights is especially well suited for clients who value speed, responsiveness, and dedicated project management. Its high-touch model makes it a strong choice for deal teams under time pressure, hedge funds running fast-moving thematic research, and consulting firms needing rapid expert access on tight engagement timelines. The firm's PE client base is particularly strong.
